biomass_low.description: Reduce biomass-burning signal to low historical background reference conditions (25th percentile).
biomass_low.physical_rationale: Simulates substantial reduction in upwind stubble burning and open fire emissions.
biomass_low.limitations: Model sensitivity estimate only; does not account for atmospheric chemical transformation dynamics.

biomass_median.description: Replace biomass-burning signal with median historical conditions (50th percentile).
biomass_median.physical_rationale: Simulates typical background biomass burning signal.

biomass_high.description: Increase biomass-burning signal to high historical conditions (75th percentile).
biomass_high.physical_rationale: Simulates peak post-monsoon stubble burning episode.

wind_stagnant.description: Set ventilation features to low surface wind speed / poor ventilation reference state (25th percentile).
wind_stagnant.physical_rationale: Simulates winter boundary layer atmospheric stagnation.

wind_normal.description: Replace ventilation features with median historical wind conditions.

wind_dispersion.description: Set ventilation features to high surface wind speed / strong dispersion reference state (75th percentile).
wind_dispersion.physical_rationale: Simulates strong atmospheric ventilation blowing away localized pollutants.

meteorology_normal.description: Replace meteorological features with median historical weather conditions.
meteorology_normal.physical_rationale: Normalizes temperature and humidity to baseline historical averages.

combined_biomass_wind.description: Combine low biomass burning (Q25) with high atmospheric ventilation (Q75).
combined_biomass_wind.physical_rationale: Simulates reduced agricultural fires co-occurring with strong dispersion winds.

combined_all_favorable.description: Combine low biomass burning (Q25), high ventilation (Q75), and median weather (Q50).
combined_all_favorable.physical_rationale: Simulates optimal environmental control and dispersion scenario.
